newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR GERMANY V UKRAINE WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR GERMANY V UKRAINE WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for World Cup group nine qualifier between Germany and Ukraine on Wednesday.

Germany - 1-Andreas Koepke, 2-Joerg Heinrich, 3-Christian Ziege, 4-Juergen Kohler, 5-Thomas Helmer, 6-Dieter Eilts, 7-Oliver Bierhof, 8-Mario Basler, 9-Juergen Klinsmann, 10-Dariusz Wosz, 11-Fredi Bobic.

Ukraine - 1-Olexander Kosovsky, 2-Oleg Luzhnyi, 3-Sergiy Bejenar, 4-Alexander Golovko, 5-Viktor Skrypnzk, 6-Sergiy Nagornyak, 7-Yuri Maksimov, 8-Yuri Kalitvintsev, 9-Vitaly Kosovsky, 10-Andriy Shevchenko, 11-Sergiy Rebrov.
